about_the_game:
A quiet rainy night in your remote mobile home was supposed to be peaceful.
But when distant sirens begin echoing across the countryside, something feels terribly wrong.

Grabbing your old VHS camcorder to document what’s happening, you begin recording the strange events unfolding outside your windows and inside your home.

Gameplay

The Unfamiliars is a first person atmospheric horror experience presented through a VHS camcorder perspective.

Players explore a small isolated mobile home while documenting strange and unsettling events unfolding outside during a rainy night.

Watch the darkness outside, investigate strange sounds within the home, and experience a night that becomes increasingly disturbing.

Uncover a story of guilt, loss, and grief, where fear takes shape, memories refuse to stay buried, and the past is always waiting in the dark.

Playtime: about 1 hour

Features

• First person atmospheric horror experience
• VHS camcorder visual style inspired by analog horror
• Exploration inside a small isolated home
• Psychological horror focused on tension, atmosphere, and sound design

⚠️ CONTENT & HEALTH WARNINGS

This game contains: 

  • Flashing lights

  • Loud Sounds

  • Sudden visual effects

  • Dark and confined environments

  • Intense & Disturbing audio cues

  • Disturbing imagery and themes

Players sensitive to flashing lights, motion effects, or horror content should proceed with caution.
